title: Oxnard Press-Courier March 30 1969 Women's World Citizenship Test Penneys Easter
conditionDescription: Single sheet (pages 13-14) of a Ventura County newspaper, not a complete paper. Toning, fold lines, small tears and nicks at the edges (pictured).
descriptionText:
Original leaf from The Press-Courier (Oxnard, Ventura County, California), Sunday, March 30, 1969 - Women's World section, pages 13 and 14. Not a complete newspaper.

Page 13:
- "Accepting Citizenship No Easy Task" by Kitty Dill - the Oxnard Adult Evening High School citizenship class, with photos of students from Japan, Denmark, Cuba and England
- "Would You Qualify for Citizenship?" - a 1969 citizenship quiz, with the Statue of Liberty and Emma Lazarus' "Give me your tired, your poor"
- "Mental Health in Spotlight - Preventing Illness Is Goal" by Marion Nichols (Ventura County Mental Health Department, Camarillo State Hospital)

Page 14:
- Citizenship test answers; "Mental Health Goal: Someone To Talk To"; Oxnard ORT event; bridge results
- Half-page Penneys "Easter is the time for eggs and Penneys shoes!" ad (downtown Oxnard), plus Fad Food at Discount grand opening in Port Hueneme and Evarts Carpet ads

Condition: original 1969 newsprint with toning, fold lines and small edge tears and nicks (see photos).

Please see all photos - they are part of the description.
